title: Quenched Ethiopian Chicken Grill
description: A rich, snappy brunch style Ethiopian chicken grill packed with berbere spice, soy sauce, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Pat the chicken thighs dry and place them in a bowl.
In a small bowl mix berbere, minced garlic, grated ginger, salt, pepper, and coconut oil to form a paste.
Coat each chicken piece with the spice paste, ensuring even coverage.
Let the marinated chicken rest for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat (about 200°C).
Grill the chicken thighs for 6-7 minutes per side, or until the internal temperature reaches 74°C.
During the last minute of cooking, baste the chicken with tamari soy sauce.
Remove the chicken from the grill and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle fresh lemon juice over the thighs and garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
